mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.1% compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.1% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) falling below 5.0% signals labor market tightening and strong economic conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous GDP (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) growth rates exceeding 0.5% annualized signals robust economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate > 0.5% and INDPRO growth rate > 0.5%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and INDPRO growth rates exceed 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rise exceeding 0.5% in three months signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in 3 months (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) above 95.0 indicates expanding manufacturing output, correlating with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 95.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 700.0 thousand units signals strong consumer demand for housing, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 700.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Joint growth in employment (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding 0.3% and 0.2% annualized rates, respectively, indicates robust labor and consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth rate > 0.3% and RSAFS growth rate > 0.2%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when both PAYEMS and RSAFS growth rates exceed thresholds (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 95.0 indicates supply chain disruption, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
